definitions.explanation: the state of having no hair on the head, or a bald spot
a patch of ground or surface with no vegetation or covering

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禿|は}げて→禿げる：20344_hageru⟧きた。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{禿|はげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にしていた→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: My father has been self-conscious about his baldness since he was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{頭頂部|とうちょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禿|はげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{育毛剤|いくもうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Since a bald spot has started forming on the top of my head recently, I started using hair growth tonic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禿|はげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There is a bare spot on the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{禿|はげ}た⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいた。
examples.english: I sowed seeds on the bare patch of the lawn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森林|しんりん}{伐採|ばっさい}→森林伐採：09285_shinrinbassai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{山腹|さんぷく}→山腹：16451_sanpuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{禿|はげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Deforestation created large bare patches on the mountainside, increasing the risk of landslides.

notes:
Can refer to both human baldness and bare patches on landscapes. When used about people, this word is considered direct and can be rude or insulting — handle with care in conversation. The verb form ⟦{禿|は}げる→禿げる：20344_hageru⟧ means "to go bald" or "to become bare."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禿|はげ}{頭|あたま}: bald head
- {禿|はげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a bald/bare spot forms
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧{禿|はげ}: completely bald
- {禿|はげ}{山|やま}: treeless mountain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄毛|うすげ}→薄毛：20459_usuge⟧: thinning hair — a more polite and indirect way to refer to hair loss
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair loss — medical or clinical term
- ⟦{禿|は}げる→禿げる：20344_hageru⟧: to go bald/become bare — the verb form
